message: no-build-references constraint flags .gitignore line ".kukulu/implement.lock" (added by run_start) because it matches Kukulu case-insensitively; verify reports ok:false regardless of the task.

kukulu_mutate reports every mutant as "killed: constraint no-build-references caught the mutation" because the pipeline-added .gitignore line `.kukulu/implement.lock` permanently fails that constraint; survivors are only visible by reading each result's command exit codes.

kukulu_mutate on docs/kukulu.json (reverting the no-build-references pattern) reported 'survived' with constraints ok: the constraint self-test does not appear to reload the mutated config, so a config-rule mutant cannot be checked through the tool; had to confirm the shouldNotMatch fixture by hand with node.
